corrected_content.problem: Find the gradient vector field of the function $f(x, y) = x^{2} - xy + 3y^{2} - 4y$.
corrected_content.worked_solution:
Differentiate the scalar function with respect to each coordinate:

$$
f_x=2x-y,\qquad f_y=-x+6y-4.
$$

Thus its gradient vector field is

$$
\nabla f=(2x-y)i+(6y-x-4)j.
$$
